title: On Dropping from the top shelf untouched
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：drop　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drop 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower ① dropped from the top shelf untouched twice over, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② drops from the top shelf untouched year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ drop from the top shelf untouched at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dropped from the top shelf untouched before — a line in the ledger for August 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dropping from the top shelf untouched twice over, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ drop the matter after the second letter year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Drop the matter after the second letter at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ drops the matter after the second letter twice over every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dropped from the top shelf untouched again when nobody else would.

⑩ To drop from the top shelf untouched, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody drops from the top shelf untouched year after year again and somebody must drop from the top shelf untouched twice over all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 掉下（一般过去式 dropped from the top shelf untouched：1989 年种植户头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 掉下（一般现在 drops from the top shelf untouched：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 掉下（不定式 to drop from the top shelf untouched：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 掉下（过去完成时 had dropped from the top shelf untouched：1983 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 掉下（动名词 dropping from the top shelf untouched 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 放下（drop the matter after the second letter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去放下第二封信后就放下了这事）
G. v. 放下（drop the matter after the second letter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 掉下（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 drops the matter after the second letter，而母亲又一次 dropped from the top shelf untouched）

drop 意为“掉下”，自那以后种植户年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 drops。

drop 意为“掉下”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要掉下从架子顶层原样落下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。
